description: This is a Python source file implementing a speech processing bot with sound effects, speech-to-text, language model interaction, and transport handling. It defines classes for sound effect wrappers, configures transport parameters, and contains an async main function to run the bot.

classes.name: OutboundSoundEffectWrapper
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that plays a sound when an LLMFullResponseEndFrame is processed.

classes.name: InboundSoundEffectWrapper
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that plays a sound when an LLMContextFrame is processed.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame, adding sound effects based on frame type.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the speech processing pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot
